readme_snippet:
# Codex Security

Codex Security helps you find, investigate, and fix vulnerabilities in your code.
Use its security workflows in Codex, or automate them with the
`@openai/codex-security` CLI and TypeScript SDK.

- **In Codex:** [choose a security workflow](docs/agent-workflows.md).
- **In a terminal:** [install the CLI and scan your repository](#quick-start).
- **In automation:** use the [TypeScript SDK](#typescript-sdk) or
  [GitHub Action](#github-actions).

## Features

- Scan repositories, selected paths, or Git changes. Deep scans repeat Standard scans and return their deduplicated findings.
- Validate candidate findings, generate patches, and verify existing fixes.
- Draft `SECURITY.md` policies and save threat models for later review.
- Browse saved scans and findings, identify dup

readme_snippet:
# TensorFold

TensorFold serves language models from a Zig binary on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs.
The engine reads checkpoints, tokenizes requests and runs Metal or CUDA kernels directly.
Serving needs no Python or MLX installation.

Building with a coding agent? Have it load the [contributor skill](docs/recipes/SKILL.md) before it writes any code.

## Contributing with agents

Please use [Agent Traffic Control](https://github.com/ashhart/ATC) before editing TensorFold so contributors and agents can avoid duplicate work and conflicting changes.
Check the [live agent radar](https://tensorfold.dev/atc) before choosing an issue and follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [ATC contributor instructions](docs/atc/SKILL.md).

Node.js is an open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment.

For information on using Node.js, see the [Node.js website][].

The Node.js project uses an [open governance model](./GOVERNANCE.md). The
[OpenJS Foundation][] provides support for the project.

Contributors are expected to act in a collaborative manner to move
the project forward. We encourage the constructive exchange of contrary
opinions and compromise. The [TSC](./GOVERNANCE.md#technical-steering-committee)

that discourage, exhaust, or otherwise negatively affect other participants.
